title: ChangeAnimFaceArchetype - Actor
content:
Member of: Actor Script Adds the specified AnimFaceArchetype keyword to this actor. Syntax: Function ChangeAnimFaceArchetype(keyword apKeyword = none) native Parameters: - apKeyword: The AnimFacceArchetype keyword to add to this actor. Default: none Return Value: None. Examples: ; Adds the AnimFaceArchetypeConfident keyword to the actor ActorToChange.ChangeAnimFaceArchetype(AnimFaceArchetypeConfident) ; Removes any existing AnimFaceArchetype keyword from the actor (sets actor back to 'Neutral') ActorToChange.ChangeAnimFaceArchetype()
